context_and_flow.screen_type: Account sign-up flow on a mobile application.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: To convert new users by guiding them through account registration.
ux_patterns: The hero illustration features a blue flag with a tree icon on a green background, reinforcing the brand identity.
The UI uses high-contrast buttons for social login.
Accessibility: The disabled 'Create Account' button at the bottom indicates a standard validation pattern where the button enables only after form completion and terms acceptance.
The hierarchy clearly separates third-party auth from traditional email/password login.
